description_target.ambiguity_notes: The official boards contain five pieces of width one or two, but the executable rule parses any number of maximal non-gap runs and treats every run wider than one column as a bend. The generated training distribution preserves the dense five-piece official grammar; broad semantic tests separately exercise the executable parser boundary.
negative_constraints: Do not treat a column as a separator when only one of its two cells is zero; both cells must be zero.
Do not classify a bend from its lower row or its full silhouette; only run width and the upper-left cell determine the move.
Do not copy input colors into the output; every traced path cell is red 2 and the fixed start marker is green 3.
Do not resize or crop the output; the result is always an 8x7 black canvas.
Do not move the start state: tracing begins at row 1, column 3 while the marker occupies row 0, column 3.
solution_steps: Mark a column as a gap exactly when both cells in that column are zero, then read the maximal non-gap runs from left to right.
Classify a one-column run as straight. Classify every wider run as left when its upper-left cell is zero and right otherwise.
Initialize the trace state at row 1, column 3.

For straight, paint the current cell and the cell below, then advance two rows. For left or right, paint the two horizontal cells on that side, then advance one row and shift one column in that direction.
Create a fixed 8x7 black grid, paint every traced cell red 2, and put a green 3 marker at row 0, column 3.
description_target.target_text: Split the two-row input into maximal runs separated by columns that are zero in both rows. Read the runs from left to right: a one-column run means straight down, while a wider run turns left when its upper-left cell is zero and right otherwise. Starting at row 1, column 3 of a fixed 8x7 output, a straight step paints two vertical red cells and advances two rows; a turn paints two horizontal red cells, advances one row, and shifts one column toward the turn. Paint a green 3 at row 0, column 3 and leave every other untraced cell black.
